description: Returns one row per ad placement (post) with the performance fields that exist for that ad type: banners (impressions, clicks, ctr, start_date, end_date, days), links (views, view_credits, ad_days, icon, bold, view_time, date_posted), youtube (impressions, start_date, end_date, days), press releases (views, start_date, end_date, days). Does not require a paid membership; available to free accounts too.

status.description: Filter placements by status. Omit to return all.

type.description: Ad type to list placements for.

name: list_posts
title: List ad placement performance
